title: Great way to spend the...
text: Great way to spend the morning! The ranch was beautiful and the horses seemed well cared for. It’s an easy way to see the monastery as well, which has beautiful views. Very knowledgeable guide - I’d be interested in one of their hiking trips as well.
author: Julianne_S

title: Highly recommend!
text:
So much fun!! Marc picked us up in the city and was a wonderful guide to and from the farm as well as through the monastery. The road is very winding and can be rough on people with motion sickness (me!) but it was very, very obvious how careful he was to be smooth and easy with his driving, and he just generally was an upbeat, knowledgeable, and welcoming host.

author: 202shaelynm

title: Worth every penny!
text: This tour exceeded my expectations in every way! Our guide, Jordi, was very knowledgeable & personable. Making sure our party was comfortable and included always! Montserrat is breathtaking & magical. Now, for the horses.. booking one of these tours is always a concern (are the horses treated properly, where will you ride, etc). But, this ranch was lovely. The horses are all loved and cared for. Our guide was amazing and the views were stunning!!
author: Q1330SOchristym

title: Magical Monsterrat day with unforgettable views and amazing guide!
text: Absolutely loved this experience, it was truly out of the ordinary. Horseback riding with breathtaking Montserrat views was incredible, and visiting the monastery added such a meaningful touch. The hike to the viewpoint was the perfect finale, offering peaceful moments and stunning scenery at the top. Marc was phenomenal, thoughtful, knowledgeable, and attentive, even providing water and sharing great local insights along the way. His hike recommendation was truly the cherry on top. title: Very nice trip
text: The guide was very friendly and explained slles very interesting. Riding was also a lot of fun. We would do it again.
author: miriamaC4407FO

title: Amazing Time
text: Really fantastic experience. So far the highlight of my time in Spain. Marc was a great guide, super knowledgeable about Spain and our activities. Would absolutely do again and recommend to family and friends.
author: 584lolat

title: A day in Monserrat
text: Excellent! The guide was on time, was knowledgeable and very nice. We absolutely enjoyed our time in Monserrat. The horse ride was also a plus. Beautiful horses, lovely place and very friendly people.
author: Gladys_G

title: Great tour - book with Jordi!
text: Jordi was an awesome tour guide! Make sure you ask to book his tour when you take the Monserrat tour with horseback riding.
author: Daydream31218609966

title: Great Tour of Montserrat!
text: Wonderful tour of Montserrat, Frank was extremely knowledgeable and had lots of fun facts. Then to be able to ride through the valley on horseback made the whole experience that much better! Would highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to visit the area.
author: BGCat99

title: Don't hesitate to book, So worth it!
text: Every thing about the tour was great! Frank was a great guide, he told us all about Montserrat and we got to see amazing views during the short hike and the horse riding was a great way to end the journey! Highly recommended.
